title: EV Charging Share of Trip Cost
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=abrp:trip
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(charging_cost_usd) as charging_cost_usd, sum(total_trip_cost_usd) as total_trip_cost_usd by vehicle _time
| eval charging_share_pct=round(100*charging_cost_usd/total_trip_cost_usd,1)
| where total_trip_cost_usd>0
| sort - charging_share_pct
description: Uses ABRP trip cost summaries telemetry to monitor what percentage of trip cost came from charging in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for vehicles or months where energy cost dominates travel spend, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest ABRP trip cost summaries data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Monthly chart of charging share of trip cost.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors what percentage of trip cost came from charging so you can spot vehicles or months where energy cost dominates travel spend before it becomes annoying.
